nextStoryContext: US-002 was a docs/prompt staleness fix on subagent-auditor.md line 3 (both .claude/ and templates/ copies): rewrote the frontmatter `description:` from 'Invoked from /cam-plan Step 8 between PRD generation and branch creation' to 'Spawned by the deterministic plan runner (runPlanPhase, ADR-0006) between PRD generation and branch creation, not a /cam-plan step', reusing the exact wording pattern from US-001 (subagent-planner.md). Kept the pre-existing READ-ONLY claim intact per the issue note; did not touch C.8/B.5 body content (that was CAM-228, already merged to main before this story ran - confirmed via git log, no rebase was needed since HEAD == merge-base with origin/main). Ran `bun run embed-vendor` to regenerate src/vendor/_generated.ts; embed-vendor:check and check-agent-frontmatter.ts both clean. US-003 (next) targets cam-plan.md's selection description for champion-vs-champion wording - a different file, unrelated to the auditor/planner theme, no shared edits expected.
